description: Tuatara Topics: find the topics in a set of documents. Returns num_topics topics, each with its words, a label, a description and a weight, plus every document's topic mixture, in one call; a dictionary model's word knowledge guides a probabilistic topic model, so topics are coherent on small sets and short texts. Nothing is trained on or kept from the request. 4 to 500 documents of up to 20,000 characters per call.

labels.description: give each topic a short label and description (default true)

num_topics.description: topics to find, 2-100 and at most half the number of documents (default 10)

name: find_topics
title: Find Topics
